claim.text: The struck vehicle became a hazard by closing within the ego lane.
The system detected the vehicle 0.231 s after hazard onset, below the 0.3 s perception threshold.
Command delay was 0.0729 s, below the 0.1 s command threshold.
Brake actuation took 0.52 s, exceeding the 0.25 s actuation threshold.
Impact occurred 1.1699 s after hazard onset.
The counterfactual with nominal timings avoided contact.
The counterfactual minimum gap was 1.3705 m.
Brake actuation is the primary contributing factor because its delay exceeded its threshold and the nominal counterfactual avoided contact.
